name: kira-mind-bot
description: Personal Telegram assistant bot for message analysis and reminders

scripts.start: if [ "$NODE_ENV" = "production" ]; then npm run start:prod; else npm run start:dev; fi
scripts.test: npm run check:privacy && npm run build:server && npm run test:unit && npm run test:built-server-runtime && npm run test:ts:all && npm run test:ai-preset-availability && npm run test:memory-embedding-http && npm run test:admin-monitoring && npm run test:server-common && npm run test:multi-instance-compose
scripts.test:agent-runtime: NODE_ENV=test KIRA_ORCHESTRATION_MODE=skills KIRA_BOT_TOKEN=1234567890:abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDE OPENAI_API_KEY=test node --test --require ts-node/register tests/agent-runtime*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm exec tsc -- --noEmit --project tsconfig.server.json && npm --prefix admin-panel exec tsc -- -b
scripts.build:server: tsc --project tsconfig.server.json && mkdir -p dist/utils dist/ai && cp utils/accountSettings.js utils/legacyPersonalitySanitizer.js utils/telegramAccess.js utils/mcpConfig.js utils/mcpConnection.js dist/utils/ && cp ai/memoryEmbeddingHttp.js ai/memoryEmbeddingProviderSupport.js ai/modelPreferences.js ai/imageRecognition.js ai/localModelRouting.js ai/local-model-roles.json ai/imageGeneration.js ai/backgroundFeatureState.js ai/activityModeCatalog.js ai/activity-modes.json ai/provider-registry.json ai/aggregator-text-models.json ai/provider-capability-overrides.json ai/fallback-models.json ai/memory-embedding-profiles.json dist/ai/ && mkdir -p dist/admin-panel && cp admin-panel/productAnalyticsStore.js admin-panel/modelPreferences.js admin-panel/presetAvailability.js admin-panel/memoryEmbeddingProfileRegistry.js admin-panel/localModels.js dist/admin-panel/ && mkdir -p dist/assets/characters/kira && cp assets/characters/kira/reference.png dist/assets/characters/kira/reference.png
scripts.build:all: npm run build:server && npm run build:admin
scripts.test:admin-monitoring: node scripts/testAdminMonitoring.js && node scripts/testAdminAiUsageAnalytics.js && node scripts/testAdminPersonality.js && npm run test:admin-memory-graph
